long_description:
WE'RE BACK! And join us, on the farm, at Manor Hill Brewing for a morning of yoga stretches, baby goats and LOTS of joy. ✨

About this Event

Join Jennifer of BreakAway Yoga on Sunday, Oct. 18th for a playful, lighthearted Goat Yoga experience at Manor Hill Brewing in Ellicott City. During this 60-minute, all-levels yoga class, friendly baby goats will roam freely through the space - bringing plenty of laughs, surprise cuddles, and maybe even a goat perched on your back while you’re in downward dog.
No yoga experience necessary. This class is designed to be approachable, relaxed, and full of good vibes. ✨ 
After class, stick around for 30 minutes of goat snuggles, photos, and hanging out with the herd, plus enjoy a complimentary beverage from the brewery.
Whether you come for the yoga, the goats, or just a fun morning on the farm, our goal is to have you leave smiling.

🎟️ Tickets: $40 (plus tax + Eventbrite service fees)Your ticket includes:
✔️ 60-minute all-levels Goat Yoga class
✔️ 30-minute goat meet-and-greet + (more) photo time
✔️ One beverage of your choice (alcoholic for those who are 21 & up or non-alcoholic)

Good to Know:🐐 Kid-friendly: Ages 6+ are welcome
⏰ Arrival: Please arrive 15 minutes early to check in
🧘 Bring a yoga mat. Mat rentals available for $5 (cash or Venmo). Blankets or large towels also work great!
📍 Location: The class takes place outdoors in the field/farm at Manor Hill Brewing.
🌧️ If weather becomes an issue, ticket holders will be notified at least 48 hours in advance via email.
Move. Laugh. Take photos. Pet some goats. Drink a beer.
Not your average yoga class — and that’s exactly the point.
💻 www.breakawayyogastudio.com
